entries.name: Фехтование
entries.desc: Attacks with finesse weapons may use Dex instead of Str (the better of Str/Dex, combat.md Maneuvers).

entries.name: Бой двумя оружиями
entries.desc: Primary hand penalty -2 less, off-hand penalty -6 less (combat.md two-weapon fighting).

entries.name: Me Liquescit
entries.desc: Stance (combat.md): no dodge bonus to AC, cannot be flanked.

entries.name: Выносливость
entries.desc: +4 on: Swim checks vs nonlethal damage from exhaustion; Con checks to continue running, vs nonlethal damage from a forced march, to hold breath, vs nonlethal damage from starvation or thirst; Fort saves vs nonlethal damage from hot or cold environments and vs suffocation damage (situational, never in a total). May sleep in light or medium armor without becoming fatigued (text).

effects.situational: Swim checks vs nonlethal damage from exhaustion
Con checks vs nonlethal damage from a forced march
Con checks vs nonlethal damage from starvation or thirst
vs nonlethal damage from hot or cold environments

entries.name: Живучесть
entries.desc: +3 HP; for every Hit Die beyond 3, +1 HP: HP bonus = max(3, Hit Dice); Hit Dice = the character level.
